from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyFinancialSnapshot(BaseModel):
    """A company's Q1 2025 balance sheet figures for the given task period."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The full name of the company")
    accounts_receivable: float | None = Field(description="Accounts receivable amount in CNY")
    total_assets: float | None = Field(description="Total assets amount in CNY")
    report_date: str | None = Field(description="The report end date in YYYY-MM-DD format")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    """All company financial data extracted from the document collection."""
    company_financial_snapshots: list[CompanyFinancialSnapshot]
